title: Module subobject equality from local section ranges
statement:
theorem module_subobject_eq_on_cover {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type v}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    {A B M : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ M) (g : B ⟶ M) [Mono f] [Mono g]
    (h : ∀ (i : ι) (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U i →
      Set.range (f.app W) = Set.range (g.app W)) :
    Subobject.mk f = Subobject.mk g

source.place: Lemma 087X, proof of claim (a): affine localization and Artin--Rees calculation

proof.text: For each open W, cover it by W intersect U_i. Range inclusion shows that g followed by the cokernel projection of f is zero on all these opens. Naturality and TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' show that this composite is zero on W. This is the proved private helper comp_cokernel_eq_zero_on_cover.

A mono is the kernel of its cokernel. Apply Abelian.monoLift and Abelian.monoLift_comp to factor each inclusion through the other. Subobject.mk_le_mk_of_comm gives both inequalities; antisymmetry proves equality. The delivered Lean proves this step and the preceding one without sorry.
